title.zh: 富兰克林邓普顿拟推两只「股息再投资比特币」ETF
title.en: 富兰克林邓普顿拟推两只「股息再投资比特币」ETF

current_state.zh: Franklin Templeton filed Form 8-A with the SEC for two Nasdaq-listed index ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT) that hold roughly 95% US equities and 5% bitcoin exposure, automatically reinvesting stock dividends into bitcoin-linked instruments.
current_state.en: Franklin Templeton filed Form 8-A with the SEC for two Nasdaq-listed index ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT) that hold roughly 95% US equities and 5% bitcoin exposure, automatically reinvesting stock dividends into bitcoin-linked instruments.
